description: Guide to drug metabolism, pharmacokinetics, pharmacogenomics, and AI in drug discovery

topics.title: Drug Metabolism (Phase I/II/III)
topics.question: How is a drug modified and eliminated from the body?
topics.focus: Enzymatic modification and clearance of xenobiotics
topics.workflow: Substrate → Phase I (oxidation/reduction/hydrolysis) → Phase II (conjugation) → Elimination
memoryHooks: Phase I: functionalization (adds or exposes a functional group)
Phase II: conjugation (adds a large hydrophilic group)

commonErrors.error: Assuming all drugs follow the same metabolic pathway
commonErrors.consequence: Incorrect prediction of metabolites and drug interactions
commonErrors.fix: Consider enzyme polymorphisms and varying substrate specificity

topics.title: Pharmacokinetics (PK)
topics.question: What does the body do to the drug over time?
topics.workflow: Drug input → absorption into bloodstream → distribution to tissues → metabolism → excretion
memoryHooks: AUC = total drug exposure over time
Half-life = time for concentration to reduce by half

commonErrors.error: Ignoring distribution phase when calculating half-life
commonErrors.fix: Use terminal slope of log-concentration vs time curve
